description: Turn CSV/TSV into SQL: CREATE TABLE with inferred column types (integer/bigint, numeric, boolean, date, timestamp, varchar/text, NOT NULL where never empty, optional primary key) and batched INSERT statements with correct quoting and escaping for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite or SQL Server. Up to 20,000 rows. POST JSON body {csv, table, dialect}. Returns JSON with: dialect, table, rows, columns, statements, sql. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/csv-to-sql
